scenario: IPADNSSystemRecordsCheck ERROR present, but dns_lookup/journal_named could not run (simulated permission denied - their fixture files are deliberately absent from this directory)
notes: This directory intentionally has no dns_lookup.json or journal_named.json, which makes both collectors raise CollectorError (permission_related=True) instead of returning items - simulating a real permission-denied failure to run dig/journalctl. With no independent corroboration available, srv-autodiscovery must not guess: it returns UNKNOWN_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with next_diagnostic_step pointing at manually running dig against every IPA DNS server in the topology plus journalctl -u named-pkcs11 as root. named-service-down and forward-zone-conflict also see no journal evidence and correctly return None.
